summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K reporting receipt of payments under Brazil's Gasoline and LPG Economic Subvention Program. The company received R$426.4 million for gasoline sales (June 1-15), R$52.8 million (May 25-31), R$13.6 million for LPG imports (May 16-31), and R$43.9 million (April 1-30). Cumulative receipts total approximately R$6.9 billion. This is a routine operational update on government subsidy payments, not a special situation transaction. No corporate event, deal terms, or strategic action is disclosed. The filing merely informs investors of government program installments received.
